# Lab 21.4: Build a Hardened Custom Image

## What We Are Going to Do
Harden a VM, turn its disk into a custom image in an image family, and allow only trusted image projects in the organization.

## Steps

1. **Create a build VM.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create image-builder --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-small \
  --image-family=debian-12 --image-project=debian-cloud --shielded-secure-boot</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Harden it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh image-builder --zone=us-central1-a --command='
sudo apt-get update &amp;&amp; sudo apt-get -y upgrade
sudo apt-get -y install unattended-upgrades auditd
sudo sed -i "s/^#\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin no/" /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sudo sed -i "s/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/" /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sudo apt-get -y purge telnet ftp || true
sudo apt-get -y autoremove &amp;&amp; sudo apt-get clean'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Stop the VM and create the image in a family.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances stop image-builder --zone=us-central1-a
gcloud compute images create hardened-debian-v1 \
  --source-disk=image-builder --source-disk-zone=us-central1-a \
  --family=hardened-debian \
  --storage-location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create a VM from the family.** It always gets the newest image.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create from-golden --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro \
  --image-family=hardened-debian --image-project=$PROJECT_ID --shielded-secure-boot</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Deprecate an old image** when you publish v2.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute images deprecate hardened-debian-v1 --state=DEPRECATED \
  --replacement=hardened-debian-v2</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Allow only trusted image projects.** In **Organization policies**, set **Define trusted image projects** (`compute.trustedImageProjects`) to allow `projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID` and the public projects you approve. VMs from other images are then blocked.

7. **Automate it later.** The same steps run in a Packer template inside Cloud Build, with a vulnerability scan before publishing.

8. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete image-builder from-golden --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute images delete hardened-debian-v1 --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Image | Patched, minimal, hardened SSH |
| Family | New VMs get the latest version |
| Old images | Deprecated, then deleted |
| Org policy | Only trusted image sources allowed |
